items.name: TACTICAL FORMATION
execution: 1/ SP performs the maneuvers required to maintain position as No2, during all the phases of flight.
2/ SP maintains position as No2, according to Techniques and Procedures Manual.

general_criteria.text: Executes clearing at the proper area, as No1 or No2, depending on relative position in the formation.
Exploits and converts the A/C energy in order to maintain position.
Is familiar with the technique and timely applies the proper corrections to alleviate any deviations from the tactical formation position.
Knows and executes all the visual signals given by the Leader.
Uses the engine with consideration to the fuel reserve.

specific_criteria.reference_text: Specific criteria of tactical turns are applied.

cross_refs: Specific criteria of tactical turns are applied.
flags: ΔΙΠΛΗ ΑΡΙΘΜΗΣΗ: το τυπωμένο «(24)» χρησιμοποιείται ΔΥΟ φορές στη σελ. 76 — εδώ για το TACTICAL FORMATION και αμέσως μετά για το «(24) – (28) TACTICAL TURNS». Για να αποφευχθεί σύγκρουση id, αυτό το item κρατά το id "formation-24" και το δεύτερο πήρε id "formation-24b". Τα πεδία numbers/heading_verbatim κρατούν την αρίθμηση ΟΠΩΣ ΤΥΠΩΝΕΤΑΙ.

Ο πίνακας Specific Criteria στη σελ. 77 τιτλοφορείται «2/ SPECIFIC CRITERIA (TACTICAL FORMATION - TACTICAL TURNS)», δηλαδή καλύπτει ΡΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ αυτό το item. Οι τιμές αποθηκεύονται μία φορά, στο item formation-24b· εδώ δίνεται ως reference.

items.name: TACTICAL TURNS DELAY 90°, DELAY 45°, IN PLACE, CROSS / HOOK / SHACKLE/ CHECK TURNS
items.heading_verbatim: (24) – (28)TACTICAL TURNS DELAY 90°, DELAY 45°, IN PLACE, CROSS / HOOK / SHACKLE/ CHECK TURNS
execution: Executes the tactical turns with comm-in or comm-out as Νº1 or Νº2.

general_criteria.text: SP checks the corresponding responsibility airspace during turn.
Exploits and converts the A/C energy in order to maintain position.
Is familiar with the correction technique in order to remain in tactical formation position.
Take initiative for safe separation during tactical turns.
Knows and executes the visual signals in a comm-out turn.
Uses the engine with consideration to the fuel reserve.
Executes clearing and ensures safe altitude for maneuvering over mountains.
Executes the tactical turns as described in the Techniques and Procedures Manual and rolls out in tactical formation position.

parameters.notes: Υποδιαστολή με κόμμα στο πρωτότυπο (±1,0 / ±0,5). Τυπογραφικό «continous» αντί «continuous» — διατηρείται ως έχει.
Στο πρωτότυπο υπάρχει κενό ανάμεσα στο «±» και τον αριθμό.

flags: ΔΙΠΛΗ ΑΡΙΘΜΗΣΗ: η επικεφαλίδα τυπώνεται «(24) – (28)» ενώ το αμέσως προηγούμενο item τυπώνεται επίσης «(24)» (σελ. 76). Το πρωτότυπο έχει επικαλυπτόμενη αρίθμηση — πιθανό τυπογραφικό του Syllabus (αναμενόμενο θα ήταν «(25) – (28)»). Δόθηκε id "formation-24b" για μοναδικότητα· το numbers=[24,25,26,27,28] αποδίδει την αρίθμηση όπως τυπώνεται.
Στην επικεφαλίδα ΛΕΙΠΕΙ κενό: τυπώνεται «(28)TACTICAL TURNS» (χωρίς space). Διατηρείται στο heading_verbatim, αφαιρείται στο name.
Ελληνικά lookalikes στο EXECUTION: «Νº1 or Νº2» — «Ν» = U+039D (ελληνικό Νι) και «º» = U+00BA (masculine ordinal) αντί «No1 / No2». Διατηρείται verbatim· κανονικοποιημένο = «No1 or No2».
Κεφαλίδα πίνακα: «MANEUVER PARAMETERS Ε 0 1 2 3 4» — το «Ε» είναι U+0395 (ελληνικό Έψιλον) εκεί όπου άλλοι πίνακες τυπώνουν «D». Η στήλη D/E είναι ΚΕΝΗ (χωρίς τιμές) και ΔΕΝ χρησιμοποιείται.

Επαλήθευση στηλών με PyMuPDF x-coordinates (σελ. 77): κέντρα κεφαλίδων 0=340.7, 1=395.7, 2=454.1, 3=505.6, 4=556.2. ΟΛΕΣ οι αριστερές τιμές κεντράρονται στο 395.7 (κωδικός 1) και ΟΛΕΣ οι δεξιές στο 505.6 (κωδικός 3). Οι στήλες 0, 2, 4 είναι κενές. Η αντιστοίχιση 1/3 είναι ΕΠΙΒΕΒΑΙΩΜΕΝΗ, όχι εικασία σειράς ανάγνωσης.
Ο πίνακας ΔΕΝ σπάει σε γύρισμα σελίδας (ολόκληρος στη σελ. 77, y=360-519). Όλα τα «±» είναι γνήσια U+00B1 — ΔΕΝ εμφανίστηκε το πρόβλημα U+FFFF σε αυτή τη σελίδα.
Ο τίτλος του πίνακα «2/ SPECIFIC CRITERIA (TACTICAL FORMATION - TACTICAL TURNS)» καλύπτει ΚΑΙ το item formation-24 (TACTICAL FORMATION).

items.name: BASIC A/C - FORMATION CONTROL
execution: 1/ As Leader

a/ Maintains A/C control, preserving flight parameters within specified limitations, during all phases of flight. Especially, constraints must be met during climb, descent, level off and cruise. Turns are allowed up to: 90° of bank when Wingman is in Fingertip; up to 60° of bank when Wingman is in Route; 45° - 60° of bank when Wingman is in Echelon and up to 30º of bank for Crossunders.
b/ Trims promptly the A/C throughout the flight phases.
c/ In dual flight, crew coordination at specific actions is applied, as described in the briefing and debriefing manuals..
d/ Maintains control of G load and formation energy awareness and keeps the formation within the assigned area.
e/ Maintains his/her orientation within flight areas.
2/ As Wingman
a/ Maintains A/C control and monitors Gs.
b/ Trims promptly the A/C throughout the flight phases.
c/ Reports to Leader immediately, whenever perceives any abnormal situation.
conditions: 3/ Maximum G load is 4 Gs and control of the A/C is smooth and positive.

general_criteria.text: As Leader
Executes the maneuvers in a smooth manner, paying attention to Wingman and without exceeding Wingman’s A/C limitations
Gives the appropriate radio calls or visual signals to Wingman before starting any maneuver or comm-out tactical turn.
Executes all checks according to the check list and informs the Wingman.
Gives the appropriate radio calls or visual signals to Wingman before any change in A/C configuration.
Knows the area borders and keeps the formation within the assigned area.
Maintains his/her orientation within flight areas and capable of returning to mother base or the alternate airport.
Keeps formation fluid, with the assistance of IP, in order to exploit fuel, weather conditions and the flight area, for the time being a Leader.
As Wingman
Maintains A/C control and monitors Gs.
Trims promptly the A/C throughout the flight phases.
Reports to Leader whenever flight parameters reach any limit.

flags: ΔΕΝ υπάρχει «2/ SPECIFIC CRITERIA» για αυτό το item — μετά το «3 Reports to Leader whenever flight parameters reach any limit.» ακολουθεί κατευθείαν η επικεφαλίδα «(30) LANDING PATTERN» (σελ. 78). Άρα kind="none", ΟΧΙ χαμένος πίνακας.
EXECUTION 1/a/: «up to 30º of bank» — το «º» είναι U+00BA (masculine ordinal) αντί «°» (U+00B0), ενώ στην ίδια πρόταση τα «90°/60°/45°» είναι κανονικά U+00B0. Διατηρείται verbatim.
EXECUTION 1/c/: διπλή τελεία στο πρωτότυπο («manuals..»). Διατηρείται ως έχει.
GENERAL CRITERIA a.1: λείπει η τελεία στο τέλος («limitations»). Διατηρείται ως έχει.
Ένθετη δομή a/ As Leader (1-7) και b/ As Wingman (1-3): αποδόθηκε με σύνθετα keys «a.1»…«a.7», «b.1»…«b.3», με τα «a» και «b» να κρατούν τον τίτλο ρόλου.

items.name: VISUAL SIGNALS
execution: SP executes and apprehends the visual signals, between the members of the formation and/or the tower, either as Leader or Wingman.

general_criteria.text: Knows and executes all the visual signals in a way that are perceivable from the other member of formation, beyond doubt.
Confirms with visual signal that he/she has understood the signals addressed to him/her.

flags: Το EXECUTION είναι μία ενιαία απαρίθμητη πρόταση (χωρίς «1/»).

items.name: CLEARING
execution: 1/ Addresses the work inside and outside cockpit dividing appropriately his/her attention, in visual and verbal (R/T) stimuli, so as to avoid a possible mid-air collision, or an imminent CFIT (controlled flight into terrain).
2/ Executes clearing as No2 depending on relative position in the formation and supports No1, who nevertheless holds the main responsibility.
conditions: 2/ SP executes clearing throughout flight, either as Leader or No2.

general_criteria.text: As Leader
Continuously checks the airspace at the full period he / she is in charge of the formation and particularly in landing pattern.
Locates timely nearby flying A/Cs and maintains the proper separation.
Conceives active or potential hazards and regulates accordingly the flight parameters in order to avoid them.
Effectively uses admissible Clearing techniques for mid-air collision avoidance.
Effectively uses the R/T for creating safe separation from the air traffic.
The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.
As Wingman
Executes clearing, depending on his/her position within the formation (always towards the Leader during fingertip).
Monitors the radio transmissions and has an explicit perception of the situation.

cross_refs: The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.
flags: Η παραπομπή στην Contact Category είναι ΕΝΘΕΤΗ (general criterion a.6), όχι ξεχωριστό specific_criteria. Στόχος παραπομπής: Contact «(36) CLEARING» (σελ. 42 PDF) → "contact-36".

items.name: RADIO COMMUNICATION
execution: 1/ Maintains R/T contact with ground stations, other A/C (depending on the case), as well as with other formation members.
2/ Contacts ground stations and gives the formal position reports.
3/ The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.

general_criteria.text: As Leader
The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.
Provides accurate information to his/her Wingman and reminds him/her functional A/C checks and fuel check.
As Wingman
Confirms every given information / direction from the formation Leader.
Monitors the Leader’s radio comm with ground stations and other A/C and interferes whenever asked or demanded for flight safety.

items.name: EMERGENCY PROCEDURES
execution: 1/ The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.
2/ Provides assistance to the formation member who suffers an emergency situation.
3/ Contacts ground stations when emergency A/C’s R/T contact has been lost.
4/ Performs lost Wingman procedures either virtually as a predetermined on VMC or actually in IMC conditions.
conditions: To fulfill the General Criteria, SP must know how to apply the Emergency Procedures:
1/ In pre-flight or post flight briefing.
2/ During the whole mission, from the engine start up to the engine shut down after the flight, if required or requested by IP.

general_criteria.text: The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.
Knows and safely performs lost wingman procedures either as a Leader or as a Wingman (VMC-IMC).
Informs the Leader timely and performs safe transition to IFR flight, when in Wingman position.
In an actual situation, informs ATC timely and obtains IFR Clearance.
Additionally, SP provides assistance to the formation member who suffers an emergency situation and contacts ground stations when emergency A/C’s R/T contact has been lost.

cross_refs: The criteria and parameters determined in the corresponding section of Contact Category apply.
